$schema: Proxy Front-End Tracking Annotation Schema v1

info.description: H-PROXY1 tracking ground truth for 6 target-domain video clips

track_id.description: Unique track identifier within a clip. Same vehicle = same ID across all frames.

x1.description: Top-left x coordinate of bounding box (pixels, 0-indexed)

visibility.description: Fraction of object visible (unoccluded): 1.0=fully visible, 0.3=mostly hidden

clip_specs.selection_criteria: 12 windows from SAMPLE_PLAN.json, first 6 windows selected deterministically

pre_annotations.description: ByteTrack outputs from all 3 detection models, merged and anonymized
pre_annotations.pre_annotation_format: Same CSV schema, with track_id values prefixed by source_idx
pre_annotations.note: Pre-annotation track_ids are model-specific. Annotators unify them into a single ground-truth track space.

priority_targets.description: Targets that MUST be annotated with full track continuity
criteria: Vehicles in ego lane or directly ahead
Vehicles in adjacent lanes showing lateral motion
